title: Storybook Story Inventory
description: Repo-wide registry of which validator kinds each component has actually implemented as stories. One file per repo, not one per component. Portable: the storyKind vocabulary in $defs is the skill pack's contribution and is not repo-specific.

inventoryVersion.description: Literal. Bump only alongside a validator change.

components.description: One entry per component that owns stories. componentId must be unique across the array.

storyKind.description: Canonical story-kind vocabulary. Order matters: validatorKinds must appear in this order.

componentId.description: Must match the stem of the component-spec filename that owns this component.

validatorKinds.description: Kinds this component claims. Must be in canonical $defs/storyKind order — an ordering rule JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the validator.

implementedStoryRefs.description: Concrete story IDs backing each claimed kind. The set of .kind values must equal validatorKinds exactly — a cross-field rule JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the validator.
